notes.notes:

[previewyoutube=LlQ6vq4RCJ4;full][/previewyoutube]

Gamers heading to [b]Gamescom[/b] will have the chance to get hands-on with some truly exciting titles covering all kinds of genres! Located in the bustling [b]Indie Arena Booth (Hall 10.2, Booth F010g - E019)[/b] we will be showcasing brand new game demos for [b]AWAKEN - Astral Blade, Steel Seed, Island of Winds, BattleJuice Alchemist and Sky of Tides[/b].

[h3]More information on the great games available to play at Gamescom:[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/458430/Steel_Seed/

[b]Steel Seed (Storm in Teacup Studio)[/b] is a single player stealth-action adventure game set in a dark sci-fi world. In her epic journey inside a hostile underground facility run by AIs, Zoe is alone with Koby, a flying drone, as her only companion. Use Zoe's parkour skills to traverse the underground facility and gain a tactical advantage. Don't forget about stealth-based techniques to explore the facility's hostile environment undetected by robotic entities and guards. Some confrontations can be avoided through efficient movement. Also, get acquainted with KOBY, because he is the master key of Steel Seed and Zoe's guide on her lonely and dangerous journey inside the underground facility. By working together, they create a formidable duo and bring something new to every fight.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1689340/Island_of_Winds/

[b]Island of Winds (Parity Games Studio)[/b] is an adventure game set in a fantastical world inspired by 17th century Iceland and its folklore. Experience the story of Brynhildur, a Balance Keeper who embarks on a journey of self-discovery. Core gameplay involves intriguing puzzles, spellcasting, and a focus on empathy encounters. The core gameplay involves spellcasting, intriguing puzzles, fantastical lore, and a special focus on approaching encounters with empathy. Island of Winds features a semi-open world environment that explores themes of self-doubt, violence, regret and empathy, as well as the conservation of nature.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1716310/AWAKEN__Astral_Blade/

[b]AWAKEN - Astral Blade (Dark Pigeon Games)[/b]. Weave your own story in this dark fairy tale 2D action-platformer metroidvania. In the mysterious ancient ruins, you will adventure with Tania to reveal her origins and fate. Is there any chance of survival in the darkest and desperate place? Slain your foes with a wide range of combos: from fastest to slowest. Parry enemy attacks to gain an advantage, use Fast Stand Up ability to get back into the fight and dash into enemies while they're attacking to slow the world around you and gain damage immunity. Combos and Skills will also help you to break through hordes of enemies and defeat bosses. Control the course of the story, help Tania make choices at the crucial moments of the game and take your own path to reveal mysteries of the past and present. Different routes may lead you to different endings. Search the Horace Islands for clues and information about mysterious and dangerous world of the AWAKEN - Astral Blade.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1120330/Sky_of_Tides/

[b]Sky of Tides (Lofty Sky Entertainment Studio)[/b] is a sci-fi narrative game set in a technologically advanced universe on the brink of war. Play as Rin, who must search for her missing father and heal the broken planet of Numen. Explore the world while your choices shape your character.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1384060/BattleJuice_Alchemist/

[b]BattleJuice Alchemist (Alchemical Works Studio)[/b] is a complex alchemy RPG that adds a unique item and skill system to the classic aRPG formula. Focus on isometric combat or opt for JRPG-style one-on-one fights. Explore the wilderness, learn ritual magic, build a tower and craft potions to fight the demonic hordes of Samhain. Juice, the alchemist, is called to Caribou Creek to fight the demons that roam the lands. As your unique version of Juice you explore the wilderness that once was New England. Fight evil in classic action RPG isometric top down view and in bullet-time close combat. Find and craft items with game-changing powers. Master BattleJuice Alchemist's deck-building mechanics by arranging your compilation of flasks to suit your playstyle. Accentuate your character beyond character customization by using ritual magic as long-term buffs. Meet strange creatures from the Crossroads while the dark plot of BattleJuice Alchemist unravels.

notes.title: REMEDIUM Act 2 - New Content Released Today!
notes.notes:
We are thrilled to announce the release of [b]the first content update of Act 2 for REMEDIUM[/b]!

Today’s content update is the first stage in the full Act 2 release, including a new location, new mutant types, boss and new story content being made available for players to experience. A further two locations, enemy types, bosses and additional story arcs will be released over the coming weeks to complete the full Act 2 launch.

[previewyoutube=bm1crfsWnqM;full][/previewyoutube]

We also pleased to announce that [b]there will be NO price increase for REMEDIUM following today’s content update[/b]. The price will only increase when we are happy with the content and quality of the game in general and Act 2 in particular. For now, the focus is delivering the most polished and content-complete version of the game during its Steam Early Access phase.  

Since the launch of Act 1, we’ve been busy gathering your feedback and introducing many quality-of-life improvements and new features, many of which were requested by players already active on the Steam Early Access release. Some of these quality-of-life improvements include the balancing of battles to make weak enemies more dynamic, a reworked dash movement, new enemy spawn mechanics, improved VFX, blood effects and HUD, as well as many other cosmetic enhancements to the game world. We will continue to work with the community on today’s update to improve and polish the upcoming content ahead of the full Act 2 release and extend our thanks for the support and feedback on REMEDIUM’s Early Access launch so far and look forward to further collaboration throughout the development journey.

Following directly on from the devastating boss battle at the end of Act 1, REMEDIUM Act 2 opens a new chapter in the hunt for a cure to the Grey plague and to your very survival in the world ravaged by hordes of mutants and chimeras. Armed only with your journal, you must navigate the snowy mountain paths and survive the onslaught of warring tribes of mutants spread across three village locations. In each new location, the blood thirsty mutants are protected by a terrifying and unique boss, which must be defeated in order to unveil the path to the cure for the disease and the survival of the remaining humans. 

[h3]REMEDIUM Act 2 features:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Act 2 will introduce three new locations with unique mutant types and terrifying bosses.
[*] Today’s update unveils the new Fort location along with new mutants and boss type - Despite their beast-like looks these mutants wear armor and use human weapons like clubs, spears and even mortars. They inhabit a ruined fortress nestled into the mountainside protected by a deadly new boss. Mutant types: Grunt, Pikeman, Gunner. Boss: Huntress. Two more locations (Mine and Abbey), mutant types and bosses, will complete Act 2 and be released soon.
[*] Continuation of the intriguing storyline of the hero’s deadly journey.  
[*] Players can craft new parts for their weapons (to further customize them and deal different types of damage) with the new reagents found in Act 2.
[*] Updated visuals and player accessibility for an enhanced gameplay experience.
[*] An improved upgrade system where players can now spend resources to become stronger. 
[*] Dash movement and Almalgams use have been split for greater accessibility.
[*] Language support for English, French, Italian, German, Spanish, Portuguese, Russian, Polish, Chinese, Japanese and Korean, with further enhancements to be added. [/list]

notes.title: BattleJuice Alchemist transmutes into action!
notes.notes:
[i]ESDigital Games[/i] and [i]Alchemical Works[/i] are delighted to reveal their action adventure RPG title [b]BattleJuice Alchemist[/b] and its new announcement trailer!

[previewyoutube=_JlygN27g1Q;full][/previewyoutube]

BattleJuice Alchemist is a complex alchemy RPG that adds an equipment-based skill system to the classic aRPG formula. Focus on top-down combat or opt for JRPG-style one-on-one fights. Explore the wilderness, learn ritual magic, and craft potions to fight demonic hordes overrunning the lands.

Juice, the alchemist, is called to Caribou Creek to fight the demons that roam the lands. As your unique version of Juice, you explore the wilderness that once was New England. Fight evil in classic action RPG isometric top-down view and in bullet-time close combat.

Find and craft items with game-changing powers. Master BattleJuice Alchemist’s deck-building mechanics by arranging your compilation of flasks to suit your playstyle. Accentuate your character beyond character customization by using ritual magic as long-term buffs. Meet strange creatures from the Crossroads while the dark plot of BattleJuice Alchemist unravels.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38469214/3a29e0c41079d009f23b3a23afabdb7c86aa9d70.jpg[/img]

[h3]UNIQUE ITEMS AND CHARACTER BUILDS[/h3]
[b]Loot and Craft[/b]: As an alchemist you wear no armor and wield no sword, but you rain down fire on your enemies. Find flasks with unique properties in the wilderness or craft them at your workbench. In deck-building fashion you create a compilation of flasks which you randomly draw from.

[b]Unique Skill System[/b]: In BattleJuice Alchemist, your flasks are your skills. Every flask can be used the normal way and at times in a supercharged, "jucified" way for stronger effects. Some flasks have powers attached to them that drastically change their effects when used, which allows you to develop your own playstyle.

[h3]EXPLORE A DARK WORLD[/h3]
[b]Procedural Landscapes, Hand-crafted Towns[/b]: The world of BattleJuice Alchemist is separated into vast levels of procedural landscape. Every valley, sea, river, mountain, building, stone, tree and item is placed by a unique algorithm. This allows you to continue exploring after you completed the main story. Quest locations are still hand-crafted to tell compelling stories.

[b]Dark Lands to Discover[/b]: You are influenced by daytime and weather effects and so are your enemies. But they are also buffed by the evermore spawning demons’ presence. Find dark altars to hold their influence at bay and discover many other secrets.

[h3]ENGAGING COMBAT[/h3]
[b]Classic isometric ARPG action[/b]: Fight your enemies from afar in classic top down view. Throw explosive or freezing flasks at them, prepare ambushes of explosive barrels. Use the “Frog Hop” flask to jump away from danger or right into close combat.

[b]Close Combat with Bullet-time[/b]: Enter close combat with an enemy, where you can interact hands on by dodging or using smoke flasks to avoid being hit. Manage your resources and flasks during these intense one on one battles against your awe-inspiring enemies from the Crossroads.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42082513/36751a6461db4323589f5a06cc1f54634ec7ed9f.jpg[/img]

notes.title: KNOW YOUR ENEMY - DEMON
notes.notes:
Demon is a powerful magical creature from the other world.

Demons are able to move to our world using portals, thereby catching their enemies by surprise. Although all creatures from our world are enemies for them, therefore these creatures are dangerous in themselves. They constantly feel rage and try to find themselves in places filled with strong emotions and energies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40097796/58d409a34b18b505bde8bbc32c8b72f0a29616d9.jpg[/img]

For the same reason, Demons have a great interest in powerful artifacts. In the game, our hero encounters this monster when the Demon teleports to steal a magic bracelet. In an effort to get it, the Demon forces the hero to join the battle. These horned creatures are usually armed with a huge fiery sword, which allows them to inflict attacks in a large radius.

However, due to the large size of the weapon and the monster itself, it is rather clumsy. Possessing high intelligence, the Demons have learned to defend themselves with the help of calling cursed souls and an aura that absorbs all the life force around. However, due to the lack of compassion and the overwhelming rage of the Demons, they often themselves cut their minions with a sword in half.

Demons can also summon fireballs falling from the sky from their world and launch fire waves at enemies with a sword. Well-timed dodges and short combo attacks are the only acceptable tactics when dealing with these powerful creatures. However, when the Demon uses a protective aura, you should run away, as your life force can easily flow to him, replenishing the monster's health.

Use the Demon's sluggishness to your advantage and try not to get involved in protracted attacks. Remember, at any time your greed can cost you a monster's health replenishment!

notes.title: KNOW YOUR ENEMY - LIZARD
notes.notes:
The Lizards are feral beadts after the experiments of necromancers, and they are essentially half-dead creatures. For this reason they are hostile to all but the undead. They are more dangerous than ordinary animals because of their increased regeneration. That's why you should not delay fighting them. 

However, you have to be careful. Lizards still possess the instincts and reactions of their relatives. Therefore, they are not only dexterous, but also cunning, as far as it is possible for an animal. Lizards like to bounce back, luring the enemy, and immediately lunge forward. Therefore, you need to be careful to put a block in time. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40097796/9c84bb66a3436fd9e7dcfaa5ee47989e3169217b.jpg[/img]

At the same time, some individuals prefer not to break without looking back at the enemy, but to sneak up quietly, waiting for the moment when, during the battle with other undead, the opponent will open to strike. At that moment, they make a decisive dash, attacking at once with sharp claws and fangs. However, compared to other opponents of the Demon Skin world, Lizards are not particularly dangerous if you block them in time and make a series of attacks without interruption. 

The main thing is to keep a close eye on the beast's lunges, placing a block in time, as well as not to let the creature excessively restore its health.

notes.title: KNOW YOUR ENEMY - NECROMANCER
notes.notes:
Our protagonist has a lot of enemies, so we continue to tell you about the creatures you will meet in the game! And today we're going to talk about Necromancers.

Necromancers are alive, reasonable and very arrogant creatures. These mages serve the Queen of Necromancers, obeying her orders without question. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40097796/1c35de4c9026b7d00590a104d9a8fe20943c1f7a.jpg[/img]

Because of their arrogance and self-confidence, Necromancers don't like to waste their energy moving around the battlefield. It's much easier for them to raise the dead over and over again by directing them at their enemies. To do this they use staffs charged with magical energy. Necromancers also use them to create protective barriers and cast a "cursed soul" spell. Necromancers cast flying skulls on their enemies, which explode upon impact with the target, or any other obstacle, creating a zone of magical fire. If the target gets too pesky and approaches at close range, Necromancers can hit the ground with their staff to create a shockwave. With it, they can knock back opponents and deal minor damage. 

However, overconfidence begets error, and most Necromancer attacks are vulnerable. For example, Magic Skulls are material, which means a skilled warrior can not only block them with the right stance but also destroy them with a timely weapon strike. Also from the skulls you can simply dodge. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40097796/daa33d3eccf5dadb08b1ed4a524904a888a1342c.jpg[/img]

If you manage to shorten the distance with Necromancer and give him a couple of quick strikes, be ready to make a somersault right away, because Necromancer will try to throw you aside immediately. And you have nothing to do but dodge the shockwave. However, be careful. If you are near Necromancer for a long time, you can be attacked by the resurrected dead from back, and it will be much harder to dodge the skulls. 

So the ideal tactic is to first destroy Necromancer's minions, then to shorten the distance, hit him a few quick blows, dodge the wave, and when the mage erects the barrier - to step back and gain stamina, destroying more dead in the process. 

Repeat until victorious!

notes.title: KNOW YOUR ENEMY - YETI
notes.notes:
Friends, we continue to tell you about the enemies you will meet in our game! And today we will talk about Yeti. 

Yeti are dangerous beasts that most often live in icy mountain caves, but sometimes they go down to the foothills in the woods to eat unwary prey. 

Since the Yeti are wild creatures, they use huge wooden clubs instead of weapons. Sometimes they decorate them with the bones of their defeated enemies, which indicates the presence of some intelligence. However, their natural instincts are stronger than their intellect, so furry giants are hostile to all other life forms and will attack anyone who is close. They live singly, as each male considers himself the king of beasts. For the same reason, they do not hesitate to run at the enemy, seeking to prove their strength. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40097796/31b699b3cccf3222ad5ffa48050ad1ccbf349dc8.jpg[/img]

Yeti is even taller than the Mechanical Golems. Because of its mighty height and enormous size, the beast's bludgeon attacks have a large radius, and it's impossible to block them. So the only thing left is to dodge them. The good thing is that it's quite easy to do this, because the blows with the club are quite slow. However, you should not bounce from this enemy very far, because it can only make him more angry. In this case, Yeti begins to stomp his feet and collapse from the ceiling of the caves giant chunks of ice. 

However you can use Yeti's aggressiveness to your advantage, getting rid of other less dangerous but no less annoying opponents with his paws. The best tactic against Yeti would be to throw a short series of punches and do a somersault behind his back. However, do not linger behind it, as this opponent is strong enough to jump up and throw all enemies away, while dealing shockwave damage. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40097796/e17d680b7a41649af22fe5e384ba08d29bd3749e.png[/img]

Against the beast it is best to use cutting weapons (axes and swords), as hammer blows are successfully absorbed by its thick fur. However, don't rely only on regular attacks. Yeti is enough formidable enemies not to spare the charge of magical attacks of artifact weapons on them. 

Good luck in the battle!

notes.title: KNOW THE ENEMY (Mechanic Golems)
notes.notes:
Friends, while the game update is being prepared, we continue to tell in more detail about the opponents you can meet in our game! And today we will talk about Mechanic Golems.

Mechanic Golems are the ingenious invention of the Dergers we talked about earlier. 

Usually Golems are armed with a hammer and pickaxe because they were created as companions of the cursed dwarves. Their main purpose is to help explore the dark depths of dungeons. And these are far from the safest places, so Golems are able to fight any enemy that threatens the Dergers. This is due to the fact that mechanic giants have no sense of self-preservation. If they see a target, they immediately start attacking it. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40097796/1e8fc2c9c10f82137176ed5e0cd5f4c63a6bcb4b.jpg[/img]

So don't underestimate these monsters, despite their slowness and lack of "real" weapons. Thanks to the mechanic core, the powerful attacks of the Golem cannot be interrupted, but they can be blocked by getting into the right stance in time and putting in maximum strength to take the blow. And if you are hoping that the Mechanic Golem will retreat after a couple of your hits, you are greatly mistaken. 

An excellent tactic against Mechanic Golems can be an attack from a distance. Take a run, do a quick punch, then roll behind this killing machine while it tries to hit back, and do another 1-2 hits. You can also use the "kick-bounce" tactic, alternating between bounces and quick hits with heavy weapons, but in this case, do not forget about your stamina. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40097796/f8a107af1278280d0903fd6bf6ce5a76627122b8.jpg[/img]

The main thing is to remember that you cannot interrupt the Mechanic Golem’s counterattack, so in no case should you go to combinations of several hits in a row. You will not be able to impress and scare him with your fighting skills, but get hit on the head with a hammer – easy.

Good luck in battle!

notes.title: KNOW THE ENEMY (DERGERS)
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! While the game update is being prepared, we would like to talk in more detail about the opponents you can meet in our game! And today we'll talk about Dergers.

Dergers are cursed dwarves.

They are usually armed with an axe or hammer. Derger differs from other enemies in that he is a sentient, not a savage creature, but at the same time the dwarf fights very fiercely. However, Derger does not forget to constantly put a block, thereby avoiding our blows (it's not for nothing that they still have a soul and a mind).

Derger has a strong instinct for self-preservation, and the dwarf is not averse to resorting to advanced combat tactics. When he sees the enemy, he can not just attack him immediately, but stand still, forcing the enemy to take the first step. During the fight, Derger also resorts to cunning. He likes to bounce back, and when the enemy relaxes and starts an offensive, he immediately makes a sharp jump forward with a simultaneous strike.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40097796/6ddd18787c84a675bdfebc0e7170632bb0597a8b.jpg[/img]

If the Derger has low HP and the situation allows, he will take the opportunity and drink the stored healing potion. Moreover, experienced warriors carry with them up to three potions at once. Therefore, Dergers are always ready for protracted battles. In a fight with them, you need to be as collected as possible and keep a short distance, constantly parrying his blows from different stances. At the beginning of the battle, each subsequent strike must be performed in a different stance. Dergers are quick to learn from their mistakes and analyze the course of the battle. If you dealt them damage with a blow from above, then the next attack from the same stance with a high degree of probability will be blocked. It is especially important to use various series of attacks and finishing moves against them in order to quickly get rid of these dangerous warriors. Tactics of single lunges and dodges without losing stamina can also help. The main thing is not to break the distance with them.

Dergers are very resourceful and have created mechanical Golems as assistants to help them explore dungeons. So don't expect a cursed dwarf to attack a mechanical golem and vice versa. Rather, they will try to unite against you. In no case should you mindlessly wave your weapon during a battle with Dergers. The dwarves will be happy to wait for the moment and counterattack you. You need to approach the battle in cold blood, not forgetting about the consumption of stamina and the blocks put on time.

Good luck in battle!

notes.title: PATCH NOTES 1.0007
How Demon Skin was created. Sharing experience with you!
notes.notes:
Hi! My name is Denis Listov and I would like to share with you my experience as a developer, as well as tell you about how the game Demon Skin was created :)

It's all started back in the 2014... It was then that I got the idea to make the game of my dreams. But at that time I had no experience, so I had to start from scratch. Programming, animation, visuals - all this had to be mastered in free time from the main work, including weekends. After six months of “intensive training”, I realized that it was definitely not possible to carry out the idea alone. I began to browse thematic forums and look for like-minded people, along the way continuing to improve my own skill.

[i]First concepts:[/i]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Rj6F9aP.jpg[/img]

At first I tried to find the same enthusiasts as me, but disputes and disagreements began that only hurt the game (unexpectedly, huh?).

[i][b]Lesson 1: Be prepared to make compromises or prepare for a quick loss of interest in the project of other developers if you defend your vision of the game, but you have nothing to pay.[/b][/i]

So it became necessary to turn to professionals, which means it was necessary to look for funding. I prepared documentation, concepts and started looking for an investor. I sent hundreds of letters to successful businessmen in social networks. And a group of wealthy young people became interested in the game. They were ready to finance the project, but made a condition that I must find a full-fledged development team. The negotiations took about two months. During this time, a programmer, animator and artist was found.

And then something happened. Many would not be surprised, but for a beginner in the gaming industry it was a shock. They called me and said:

[i]“Well, now you have a team, well done. And we consulted again and decided that we did not want to invest yet.”[/i]

I was very surprised, because all this time we communicated positively, and it seemed that they would agree... but life turned out to be cruel :)

[i][b]Lesson 2: When concluding any important agreements, always draw up official documentation that you can use if something happens. Even if you are "in a very good relationship."[/b][/i]

As my try to get funding failed miserably, I loaned bank money to pay salaries and proceed with the development. I hoped that it will be way easier to find funding with at least some parts of the future game at hand. Unfortunately, there were not much to show anyone at early stage of the development. Unfortunately, there has been little progress at this stage. Some specialists did not always understand the technical tasks, which I set and did in their own way, so there were a lot of ‘re-dos’ and delays.

[i]The first options for the appearance of the character:[/i]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/L8WbYH3.png[/img]

[i][b]Lesson 3: learn to immediately set specific, understandable and detailed requirements for the task being performed. It's better to spend time explaining at the beginning than reworking later.[/b][/i]

On the other hand that was when the team realized – 3D is a must. There are too many animations for every character and it’s easier with the polygon modeling as you don’t have to draw every single frame and it saves a lot of time with the pre-made animations.

[i][b]Lesson 4: if you want more lively and detailed animations in your game, then think about 3D at the start, this greatly simplifies the process.[/b][/i]

Along the way, I kept looking a new investor. With the early pre-alfa version ‘The Forging Destiny HROFT’ we started a crowdfunding campaign at Boomstarter.

There were no big hopes about this platform, but the we wanted to test the crowdfunding mechanics anyway. All in all the project raised just about $250 out of the projected $15 000. There was a good thing though – the new investor expressed a desire to fund the project if they cut the budget. This was their only option so they had to agree to this term. With this funding we finished the first game build and designed a lot of 3D-models (most of which are still in the game).

As time went by, the team ran out of money and we had to cease the development. No one believed at this point that they could ever release the title. All of my staff told me that if I want to do something right, I have to learn how to do it by myself. That to create a game of this level I have to master programming, animation and stuff. Obviously that wasn’t the goal for just 3 or 4 years. Not to mention other development tasks needed to be done. Sure, I could have started with something less complicated but this game was the only thing I could think about! I still didn't want to compromise xD

Meanwhile the game’s community was growing rapidly. The gamers saw that despite all odds I didn’t give up and just kept working. Some of them (designer, animation designer and programmer) even joined the team without any pay! The gameplay as well as the most of the characters and the narrative had been revised and the game changed its name to A.S.H. (About Savior Hunter).

[i][b]Lesson 5: Even if it is very difficult, but you see that there is a chance - try and continue. Sometimes fate also brings positive surprises.[/b][/i]

While pursuing my dream I made some desperate decisions – sold my car to pay for a motion capture studio to make character moves look as real as possible. First try was a failure, though. The studio didn’t even considered the reference moves I provided them with, so I decided to take a train to Moscow (I live in Archangelsk, over 620 miles from there) get into the mocap suit and capture all the character moves he needed in the exact way I wants them to look like.

It had never happened to me before. As I was practicing the moves before the capture session I stretched my leg so hard that I barely could walk. They told me it could take up about 10 days to recover but my mocap session was in two days. I could not reschedule it everything was already arranged and paid. With some painkillers I had managed to get there and after the 5 hours of motion capture (and pain!) we somehow recorded all the moves I wanted.

[i]After long hours of waving a stick:[/i]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/a1mGFYQ.jpeg[/img]

After a while, we gave crowdfunding another chance and started a new campaign. Only this time - on Kickstarter. Lack of the marketing caused another failure despite the title raised more than a $1000 in pledges. It didn’t help much though, and the team broke up again seeing their goals unachievable. Once again I had to find an investor to resume the development. And after a couple of months I found one. On a strict condition that I had to gather a new team and find a publisher first. Finding a publisher was quite a challenge and yet I somehow pulled it off. And yet It's all has been for nothing – after a week the investor informed me that they are not going to support my project.

At some point my family pushed me pretty hard to drop this project as I put way too much effort into it with little avail. Well, there was some progress in development, but it definitely wasn’t enough. I started to realize that something pushes investors away so I had to find a common ground with them…

[i][b]Lesson 6: Do not forget about lesson 2 and if you see that people are not very interested in your game, stop and try to find out what exactly pushes gamers and investors away.
[/b][/i]
I continued to post information about the game on hundreds of sites in search of investors. Requests came from different countries, they say "your game is very interesting to us", but after a couple of weeks the investors disappeared. By this time I began to approach the issue of discussing investing much more seriously and after about couple of months of he negotiations the contract had been signed and development was on again. I could finally gather a team of professionals to develop a playable game build I would be proud of. With two new programmers, level-designer, animation designer and two part-time 3D-modelers.

For the next 2 months, intensive work was also carried out with the composer and sound engineer. Actually, all team members are contract workers implementing the game designer ideas for a salary. In so doing, they are did their best. Ludus Future team worked about 12-16 hours a day and sometimes willingly on weekends (everything, of course, was paid and no one was forced to work). I don't like the word "studio", as I find it too formal, and I still like to think that my team is more about friendship, despite the fact that all team members live in different regions of Russia.

After six months of hard work, we got a new build called Demon Skin. I actively communicated with the team and listened to the opinions of other people, and as a result, the game's plot changed, as well as the main character. We sent Demon Skin to DevGAMM Online event and UEDC-2020.

[i]The final look of the game:[/i]
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1522140/ss_948194a75e00cff5b7fb21d69d4b2942cc6c7c12.1920x1080.jpg?t=1618846776[/img]

Now Demon Skin is 3D platform game with RPG elements mainly focused on the melee combat. And I still finds its melee combat system the best one i know in this genre (inspired mostly by Severance: Blade of Darkness). I literally put my soul into the combat system xD


RESULTS

And now, after almost 7 years of blood and sweat, life lessons and overcoming I finally finished my game and now it's on Steam! I learned a lot, I managed to find investors at different stages of development, a team of professionals, and also bring the game to the point of "finished product".

[b]And all this would have been impossible without your support all these years. Many of you already know this story, and I hope that Demon Skin has become as dear to you as it is to me :) Thank you![/b]

notes.title: PATCH NOTE 1.0002
notes.notes:
We heard you and have already prepared the first pack of fixes for the game!
First of all, the evil Necromancer now correctly "gives out" the scroll after defeating him. Now your walkthrough is completely safe 😊

Secondly, from now on you will not feel completely defenseless when a crowd of enemies threw you to the ground. The hero will not take damage until he gets to his feet!
Ice Spikes will no longer deal damage based on which part of your body you touch them. After the update, Ice Spikes will always remove the same amount of HP.
We also worked a little on the video insert "Chalice of Fate", in our humble opinion, now it looks much better!

Well, for sweetness: we managed to find and eliminate the error when, in the battle with the Demon, the hero could fall and lose control. Nothing will stop you from kicking his ass!

We continue to work on improving the game and a fresh update is coming soon. You asked for the ability to skip cutscenes before the boss battles - we are working on it! We also intend to exclude sudden turns of the character during movement and attempts to strike. Plus you will be able to assign the buttons to the controller. After all, demons will not return our souls to us until we bring the game to an ideal state ...

______________
Brief summary of patch 1.0002
1. Fixed a bug with the Scroll of the Necromancer. Now the scroll does not disappear after the death of the latter.
2. Fixed a bug with the inability to rise after falling in battle. Now the hero does not take damage until he gets to his feet.
3. Fixed a bug with damage from Ice Spikes. Now they inflict the same damage regardless of what the hero touched them with.
4. Improved quality of the "Chalice of Fate" video insert.
5. Fixed a rare bug, when in the battle with the Demon after the fall of the hero lost control.
________________________
In the upcoming patch you will find:
1. Skip rollers in front of bosses.
2. The character will not turn when moving forward and trying to strike.
3. It will be possible to assign gamepad buttons.
